execution: every successful scheduled or manually dispatched fundamental workflow

methodology.ownerCashFlow: CFO-CAPEX-SBC economic charge; SBC noncash and residual dilution must not be counted again
methodology.maintenanceCapex: use disclosed maintenance/growth split only as actual; otherwise scenarios anchored to D&A, never a verified split
methodology.acquisitionReturn: post-close incremental NOPAT or incremental owner FCF / all-in acquisition invested capital; requires target or segment data and ≥2 post-close periods
methodology.acquisitionHurdle: consideration multiplied by required cash-on-capital return; hurdle not actual ROI
methodology.forwardCash: management revenue guidance × independently observed historical owner cash conversion margin; scenario, never company FCF guidance
methodology.forecasts: separate management_guidance, market_consensus, model_derived, market_implied; never relabel one as another
methodology.historicalMultiple: same fiscal basis, share splits, currency; report divergence rather than force price target

INTU.sourceLabel: Intuit FY2026 Q4 and FY2027 guidance

CPRT.considerationNature: announced equity consideration, not confirmed enterprise purchase price
CPRT.managementExpectation: accretive to EPS FY2028 and beyond (not a realized return)

CSU.TO.note: Requires acquisition-cohort purchase cost and standalone post-close operating cash evidence; no realized ROI imputed

coverage.internationalFinance: Issuer historical FCF and revenue guidance alone do not meet investment-grade gating
